headline: YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen
conceptNote: 濃紺の中で、Live Chatのセリフ体と映像の赤いアクセントを響かせる。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. ONE finished sophisticated Chrome Web Store promotional tile, landscape 11:7, target1760x1120 pixels, compact composition NOT a panorama. This is a typographic brand graphic explaining fullscreen video WITH chat overlaid INSIDE the video. Design typography and the video/chat drawing TOGETHER as a cohesive composition, with deliberate surrounding negative space and optical alignment.
Only visible text, VERBATIM: "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen". Preserve this EXACT reading order: YouTube → Live Chat → Fullscreen. Line breaks are allowed as specified, but NEVER put Fullscreen before Live Chat. No additional text, labels, numbers, captions or watermark. YouTube is NOT an oversized separate corporate logo; all words belong to one product name. Fullscreen is a single word. Beautiful font design, normal-width bespoke editorial sans unless a variant below calls for serif: regular/medium weight, carefully kerned, comfortable leading. Never chunky default bold, ultra-condensed, bevelled or 3D typography. Every word must be easily readable when reduced to220x140.
The diagram must be large enough to communicate the function at220x140, NOT a tiny decorative icon. One16:9 video surface with four clear fullscreen corner marks, a play triangle in the unobstructed video area, and ONE chat panel fully inset inside the video with space around all its sides. Abstract chat: three avatar dots + short message strokes + discreet input line, NO words or invented conversation. Chat covers only about25% of the video's width. No outside sidebar. Refined controlled strokes and limited flat palette, no plastic, glass sculptures, paper craft, heavy grain, 3D shadows, sci-fi glow, fake scene, real screenshot, people or photographic monitor. Keep all text and important shapes within7% outer safe margins. Make the entire tile feel like one deliberately composed brand identity; use generous whitespace without leaving empty disconnected regions.
Specific art direction: Deep midnight navy background, warm-white and muted vermilion. Upper-left editorial product-name lockup 'YouTube' / 'Live Chat' / 'Fullscreen', where Live Chat is elegant readable serif italic, other words refined normal-width sans. Upper type block occupies about40% height. LOWER55%: broad video fullscreen frame with warm-white corners and tiny red play mark; a light translucent-looking but flat-color chat rectangle INSIDE LEFT side of video, leaving remaining video area on right. Carefully align letter stems and frame edge; quieter, contemporary editorial mood with controlled negative space.
Critical content clarification: The VIDEO SURFACE IS EMPTY SOLID COLOR, no scene whatsoever: no mountains, no lake, no trees, no sky, no sun, no scenery. It is a clean diagram, not a thumbnail illustration. For a TOP/BOTTOM layout, keep the name in roughly the top quarter of the canvas and make the video about65% of canvas width (preserving16:9), centered or aligned as described below it, with a breathing gap. Never stretch a screen into an ultrawide banner. For side-by-side layouts preserve the stated proportions. Treat this as a finished high-end brand graphic, not a scene or mockup.
